content.short: Sei is a high-performance Layer 1 blockchain optimized for trading and the first to feature parallelized EVM.
content.description:
Sei is an ultra-high-speed, open-source Layer 1 blockchain specifically engineered to optimize the exchange of digital assets. With its V2 upgrade, Sei became the industry's first parallelized EVM blockchain, allowing Ethereum-based smart contracts to benefit from its high-performance infrastructure without code modifications. The network achieves unparalleled throughput of up to 12,500 TPS and sub-400ms block finality through its unique "Twin-Turbo" consensus mechanism.

Designed to eliminate common blockchain bottlenecks, Sei serves as a foundational layer for high-frequency DeFi, NFT marketplaces, and gaming applications. The network is powered by the $SEI token, which facilitates transaction fees, staking, and decentralized governance. Through its commitment to extreme performance and developer accessibility, Sei is building the essential framework for a more scalable and efficient decentralized economy where trading is a globally accessible and verifiable utility.
